title: Produce checkbox component audit sheet
description: Audit the checkbox filter as an individual component, preserving native semantics while defining its visual, layout, state, and Elementor styling needs.
objective: Turn checkbox from a generic option renderer into a documented component with explicit anatomy, checked/focus/disabled states, layout contracts, and a Guilherme QA scenario.
acceptance_criteria: Checkbox input, option label, group label, selected state, focus, hover, disabled, spacing, and count/visual slots are treated as separate subelements.
Native checkbox semantics are preserved instead of replaced by a visual-only control.
Shared option-family controls are separated from checkbox-only controls.
The audit does not implement checkbox fixes yet.
verification: No plugin source changes are made.

budgets.context_budget: checkbox render, option parser, option CSS, frontend JS

risks: Checkbox can accidentally inherit radio/chip assumptions and lose its multi-select affordance.
Over-customizing the input can break accessibility or browser behavior.
